text: A bridge needs beams, not a hopeful sign. A spin bridge needs an equation carrying the parent's rotation into the baby. Our shrinking star illustration shows the newer collapse first. This paper contains no plots. The entire argument is equations. Then, the lone source card appears. Across all four papers, no equation carries the parent's spin through the bounce. The collapse papers mention it in exactly one sentence. It would still be valid for a more realistic gravitational collapse of an inhomogeneous and rotating fluid. That line supplies no rotating model or axis calculation. So how loud could the missing bridge be?
